objective:
A Python task scheduler that runs units of work in dependency order.

It should provide: a task definition carrying a name, a callable, and the names
it depends on; a graph that detects cycles and reports the offending path; a
topological ordering that groups tasks into levels which could run in parallel;
a sequential executor that runs the levels in order and records per-task
duration and outcome; a retry policy with a maximum attempt count and a
configurable backoff; failure propagation that skips dependents of a failed
task and reports them as skipped rather than failed; a run report summarising
succeeded, failed and skipped tasks; persistence of a run report to JSON; and a
command line interface that loads task definitions from a Python module and
runs them.

Pure standard library.
